Rodriguez Phinney Ridge
The Most Versatile Bike Made
Whether it's gravel grinding, road riding, or daily commuting, the Phinney Ridge from Rodriguez is your disc brake warrior. Our fork design with 55mm of rake, allows for more tire clearance and proper handling. The Phinney Ridge is versatile, affordable, and made in the U.S.A.
• Choose your wheel size (26", 650b or 700c)
• Hand crafted in Seattle for your unique needs
• No compromise on comfort - It's just your size!
• Ride anywhere! Great for gravel or road
• A favorite for Seattle commuters
• Our custom fork allows wider tires + fenders + toe clearance
• Front and rear rack braze-ons
• Anything else....Just ask!

Yes! We ship bikes anywhere. Quick facts:
Depending on wheel size you can run up to 54mm wide tires. The Phinney Ridge is American made from high quality, butted, light-weight steel tubing that Rodriguez road bikes are famous for. We offer the Phinney Ridge with a selection of SRAM or Shimano equipment. Every Phinney Ridge comes with a pair of handbuilt wheels with a 2-year warranty . It's a comfortable, versatile bike that is perfect for a rainy day commute and our fit is guaranteed.
Make your Phinney Ridge fly with the Rodriguez Travel Option.
